revenue.title: Protocol Revenue Dashboard
revenue.description: Factoring-fee revenue over time, treasury status, and funded-volume metrics — all sourced from on-chain state.
revenue.error: Failed to load revenue data. Please try again.
revenue.treasuryNotConfigured: No treasury address configured on the pool contract yet.
revenue.treasuryPollNote: Treasury balances refresh automatically every 30 seconds.
revenue.dataNote: Revenue figures reflect on-chain state and pool events. Historical chart series are derived from current cumulative totals, and event-derived figures (last withdrawal, unique lenders) cover the trailing 30 days of activity; a full time-series store arrives with the event indexer.

kyc.title: KYC / Investor Whitelist
kyc.description: Control investor eligibility for pool deposits. When KYC is required, only approved addresses may deposit.
kyc.kycRequired: Currently REQUIRED: Unapproved investors cannot deposit.
kyc.kycNotRequired: Currently NOT REQUIRED: All investors may deposit freely.
kyc.note1: When KYC is disabled, all investors may deposit freely.
kyc.note2: Approvals are stored on-chain; revocation takes effect immediately.
kyc.note3: Existing positions are not affected by KYC status changes.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Sanctions screening queue, decisions, and monitoring alerts.

monitoring.title: Storage Health
monitoring.costDisclaimer: Approximation — actual costs vary with entry size, TTL settings, and network fee schedules. XLM/USDC rate: ${rate}.
monitoring.cleanupDescription: Removes terminal invoice entries (Paid, Defaulted, Cancelled, Expired) from persistent storage. Active invoices are never touched. Callable by anyone — no admin auth required.
monitoring.cleanableBanner: {count} expired invoice(s) can be cleaned up to save ~{xlm} XLM/month

defaults.title: Overdue Invoices
defaults.description: Monitor and manage invoices that have passed their due date without repayment.
defaults.noOverdue: No overdue invoices currently requiring default management.
defaults.policyLine1: Invoices are considered Overdue once the ledger timestamp exceeds the registered due_date.
defaults.policyLine2: Marking an invoice as Defaulted is a protocol-level event that permanent stamps the invoice state.
defaults.policyLine3: Defaulted status negatively impacts the SME's platform credit score and prevents future invoice tokenization.
defaults.policyNote: Note: This administrative action is strictly restricted to the authorized Pool governance address.
defaults.modalDesc: This will permanently mark Invoice #{id} as defaulted, seize any collateral ({amount}), and reduce the SME's credit score by 50 points. This action cannot be undone.
defaults.defaultedInvoice: Invoice #{id} has been marked as DEFAULTED.
defaults.defaultingFailed: Failed to mark invoice as defaulted. Note: This action may require specialized contract permissions.

liquidity.title: Liquidity Forecast
liquidity.description: Projected available liquidity vs queued withdrawal demand, per token.
liquidity.error: Failed to load liquidity data. Please try again.
liquidity.connectWallet: Connect a wallet to submit a drain transaction.

yield.title: Pool Fee Management
yield.description: Configure borrower pricing for the Astera liquidity pool.
yield.yieldExample: Example: 8.5% is equivalent to 850 basis points.
yield.factoringFeeDesc: This fee is locked when an invoice becomes fully funded and is charged on top of borrower interest at repayment.
yield.rateCurveDesc: Utilization-driven pricing per token. New parameters go through the standard timelocked proposal flow; already-funded invoices keep their locked rate.
yield.noCurve: No curve configured yet — new fundings use the flat yield rate above.
yield.hasCurve: This token has an active curve — the flat yield rate is inert for its new fundings.
yield.slope1Hint: Rate added from 0% to the kink
yield.proposalNote: The proposal becomes executable after the on-chain timelock (48h default). Anyone can execute it once the timelock elapses.
yield.safety1: The contract enforces a maximum yield of 50.00% (5000 bps).
yield.safety2: The contract enforces a maximum factoring fee of 100.00% (10000 bps).
yield.safety3: Curve parameters are capped at a 50.00% (5000 bps) max rate.
yield.safety4: Yield changes apply to active and new funded invoices at repayment time.
yield.safety5: Factoring fees are locked when an invoice becomes fully funded.
yield.safety6: Once a token has a rate curve, the curve prices its new fundings and the flat yield rate is inert for that token (it remains the fallback for tokens without a curve).
yield.yieldRangeError: Yield must be between 0% and 50% (5000 bps).
yield.feeRangeError: Factoring fee must be between 0% and 100% (10000 bps).
yield.rateModelProposed: Rate model proposal submitted for {token}. It becomes executable after the timelock elapses.
yield.rateModelProposalFailed: Failed to propose rate model change.
yield.optUtilRange: Optimal utilization must be between 1 and 10000 bps (0.01%–100%).
yield.maxRateRange: Max rate must be between 1 and {max} bps.
yield.baseRateNonNegative: Base rate must be a non-negative integer (bps).
yield.baseRateExceedsMax: Base rate cannot exceed the max rate.

aging.title: Invoice Aging Report
aging.description: Overdue and at-risk invoices grouped by aging period.
aging.noFundedDesc: Funded invoices will appear here once the pool starts lending.
aging.noOverdueDesc: All funded invoices are current on their payments.

exchangeRates.title: Exchange Rates
exchangeRates.description: Set USD-denominated exchange rates for each accepted stablecoin (in basis points). Used for normalised pool reporting across currencies.
exchangeRates.note1: Default rate is 10000 bps (100% of USD = 1:1).
exchangeRates.note2: EURC at 1.08 USD would be entered as 108 (= 10800 bps internally).
exchangeRates.note3: Rates are used for display/reporting only; pool accounting stays in native token units.
exchangeRates.reviewDesc: Please confirm the exchange rate update for {token} before it is submitted on-chain.
exchangeRates.success: Exchange rate for {token} set to {pct}% of USD ({bps} bps).
exchangeRates.rateMustBePositive: Rate must be a positive number (e.g. 100 for 1:1 with USD).

oracles.title: Oracle Network
oracles.description: Registered oracles vote on invoice verification with weight proportional to their staked amount. Once approving or rejecting weight crosses the quorum threshold, the invoice contract is updated automatically.
oracles.notConfigured: The N-of-M staked oracle consensus registry isn't configured (NEXT_PUBLIC_ORACLE_REGISTRY_CONTRACT_ID is unset), or the deployed contract could not be reached. This page becomes active once a oracle_registry contract is deployed and the invoice contract's set_oracle_registry has been called.
oracles.noRound: No verification round found for that invoice.
oracles.expiredResolution: Oracle participation never reached quorum before the deadline. As admin you can resolve this round directly so the invoice isn't permanently stuck.
oracles.note1: Votes are weighted by each oracle's staked amount, not a flat 1-address-1-vote.
oracles.note2: Slashing permanently reduces an oracle's withdrawable stake — this cannot be undone.
oracles.note3: Admin fallback resolution is only available once a round has expired without reaching quorum.
oracles.slashModalDesc: This permanently reduces this oracle's withdrawable stake. Use for a proven-bad verdict, paired with the invoice dispute-resolution flow.
oracles.slashBpsRangeError: Slash bps must be between 1 and 10000.

attestors.title: Credit Score Attestors
attestors.description: Register external attestors (business registries, credit bureaus, other protocols) whose verified signal blends into SME credit scores, and review disputed attestations.
attestors.weightRangeError: Weight must be between 1 and 10000 bps.

governance.description: Create, vote on, and execute governance proposals for protocol parameter changes.
governance.createProposalDesc: Proposal creation will be implemented once the governance contract is deployed and configured.
governance.proposalCreationNotImplemented: Proposal creation requires the governance contract to be deployed and configured. This feature will be available after contract deployment.
governance.actionSetInvoiceGracePeriod: Set invoice grace period to {days} days
governance.actionSetOracleRegistryInvoiceContract: Set oracle registry invoice contract to {address}
governance.actionSetComplianceRescreeningInterval: Set compliance rescreening interval to {secs} seconds
